name: Whiteboard
description: Persistent, live-synced HTML canvas — set/patch content, broadcast changes over a WebSocket to every open viewer, round-trip with a presentation. Migrated from the aw monolith (src/api/routes/whiteboard.py + whiteboard_manager.py + WhiteboardWindow.jsx).

default_board_id.description: Board id the nav entry opens by default.

presentation_api_base.description: Base URL of a presentation API to round-trip boards with (load_presentation/save_presentation). aw-workspace does not ship one yet — see README. Leave unset to disable the round-trip (returns 501).
